name: secretsmanager-prove-no-consumer-before-destroy
description: Prove nothing consumes an AWS Secrets Manager secret before a terraform plan destroys it: query CloudTrail per resource, classify GetSecretValue (a real consumer) against DescribeSecret/GetResourcePolicy (your own CLI and posture scanners), subtract your own terraform refresh, and check reversibility separately -- because a populated LastAccessedDate is not evidence of use.
